title: 目標達成の後に・目指すはテッペンでい

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, close to the end of Inari One's junior year…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I think this one went pretty well, Boss! How's my time?!
choice_data_list: You're right, you hit your target again!
You're right, you hit your target again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I think this one went pretty well, Boss! How's my time?!
choice_data_list: You're right, you hit your target again!
You're right, you hit your target again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Looks like we hit the sweet spot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In fact, Inari One has progressed far beyond my expectations. At this rate, we should be able to tackle bigger races starting next year!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss. Can we have a little chat durin' break?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Boss. Can we have a little chat durin' break?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm nearin' my classic year, so I wanted to get your advice on somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I thought about this all through my junior year… What could I do to make a big name for myself, to get everyone's eyes on me?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: After all that thinkin', I came up with an idea to reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If you're the best in the field, no one's got a choice but to look up to ya… Right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to make reachin' the top my next goal!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But just reaching the top isn't enough for me. Which is why I gotta do it twice! I'm aimin' for both the top of the centrals and the regionals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: As a transfer who grew up with the regionals, I think this monument of a goal is somethin' only I can do.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So, tell me, whaddya think?
choice_data_list: I think it's an amazing goal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The top, the best, the strongest… Everyone is different in how they define what they see as the pinnacle of success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And this particular goal screams "Inari One." With a personality like hers, she can definitely grab the attention of the masses!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, glad we're on the same page! Now here's where things get sticky…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's easy to say I wanna reach the top of the regionals and centrals, but how exactly do I do it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I think it's gonna take more than winnin' a buncha races. I just can't pin down what that "more" could be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During her classic year, she can dominate the Tokyo Daishoten at Oi Racecourse. Then, in her senior year, if she performs well in central G1s…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That could earn her the prestigious title of Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would prove Inari One, the transfer from the regionals, is a top-class runner.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: THAT SOUNDS AMAZIN'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I love that idea! There couldn't be a better way to stand boldly in front of everyone and declare, "I'm on top of the world!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's settled. After dominatin' the regionals, I'm gunnin' for Umamusume of the Year in the centrals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Startin' today, that's the kind of "top" I wanna aim for!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, the first hurdle we've got comin' is the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tokyo Daishoten won't be happening until the end of next year. In the meantime, we should focus on getting more experience at Oi Racecourse!
choice_data_list: Let's enter the Japan Dirt Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Dirt Derby happens to be the biggest dirt race in a runner's classic year, making it the perfect stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I get it. Ya want me to test my strength first. Hey, standin' at the top of the Japan Dirt Derby doesn't sound half bad!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! I'm all fired up now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we get ready to start the classic year with a new goal to reach the top!
